clips.send: Common mix-up: Temperature and heat are not the same. Heat is energy that is moving from a hotter object to a colder one.
clips.text: Common mix-up: Temperature and heat are not the same. Heat is energy that is moving from a hotter object to a colder one.

clips.send: Common mix-up: It is not “heat rises” — it is warm FLUID that rises, because it is less dense. Heat itself can move in any direction.

clips.send: Conduction (pot bottom). Heat passed on by touching. Where the hot coil touches the pot, the fast-vibrating particles of the coil bump into the particles of the pot. Each particle passes energy to its neighbour, like a crowd passing a ball. The particles themselves stay in place. Conduction is fastest in solids — especially metals — because their particles are packed tightly together.

clips.send: Common mix-up: A sweater does not make heat. It is an insulator that slows the loss of YOUR body heat.
clips.text: Common mix-up: A sweater does not make heat. It is an insulator that slows the loss of YOUR body heat.

clips.send: Oven mitt and wooden handle (insulators). Slows down heat transfer. Insulators are poor conductors: wood, plastic, cloth, foam, rubber and air. Switch the handle to Wood: the far end stays cool even when the water boils. An oven mitt traps lots of tiny pockets of air. Still air is an excellent insulator.

clips.send: Radiation (glowing coil). Heat carried by electromagnetic waves. The red-hot coil gives off infrared radiation in all directions — hold your hand beside it (never on it!) and you feel the warmth. Radiation needs no matter. That is how the Sun’s energy crosses 150 million km of empty space to reach Earth. Dark, dull surfaces absorb radiation well; shiny, light surfaces reflect it.

clips.send: Thermometer (temperature). Measures how hot or cold. Temperature measures the average kinetic energy of the particles in a substance. Faster particles equals higher temperature. Water boils at 100 degrees Celsius and freezes at 0 degrees Celsius (at sea level). The liquid in the thermometer expands when it warms up, so it rises up the tube.

clips.send: Metal handle (conductor). Lets heat pass through easily. Metals are good thermal conductors: heat travels quickly from the hot pot along the handle. Metals contain free electrons that move around and carry energy fast. Watch the handle glow and its particles vibrate faster near the pot. After a while the far end is too hot to touch!

clips.send: Convection (water currents). Heat carried by a moving fluid. Water at the bottom warms up, expands and becomes less dense, so it rises. At the top it cools, becomes denser and sinks down the sides. This loop is a convection current. Convection happens only in fluids (liquids and gases): boiling water, sea breezes, a room heated by a radiator, even hot rock deep in Earth’s mantle.

clips.send: Steam (thermal energy). Energy of moving particles. Thermal energy is the total kinetic energy of all the particles in an object. As the water gains thermal energy its molecules move faster. The fastest ones escape from the surface as water vapour. When boiling, the extra energy breaks the water molecules apart from each other instead of raising the temperature, so boiling water stays at 100 degrees Celsius .

clips.send: Common mix-up: “Radiation” here does not mean anything dangerous or radioactive. Infrared radiation from a toaster or campfire is just heat travelling as waves.

clips.send: 对流（水中的环流）。靠流体的流动传递热量。锅底的水受热后膨胀，密度变小，于是上升。上升到顶部的水冷却后密度变大，沿着锅壁下沉。这样循环流动就形成了对流。对流只发生在流体（液体和气体）中：烧开水、海陆风、暖气片使整个房间变暖，甚至地幔中炽热的岩石也会缓慢对流。

clips.send: 热辐射（发红的电炉丝）。以电磁波的形式传递热量。烧红的电炉丝向四面八方发出红外线，把手放在旁边（千万别碰！）就能感到热。热辐射不需要任何介质。太阳的能量就是这样穿过 1.5 亿千米的真空到达地球的。黑色、粗糙的表面容易吸收热辐射；白色、光亮的表面容易反射热辐射。

clips.send: 隔热手套与木手柄（绝热体）。减慢热量的传递。绝热体（热的不良导体）导热很差，例如木头、塑料、布、泡沫、橡胶和空气。把手柄切换成“木头”：即使水烧开了，手柄末端仍然是凉的。隔热手套里有许多微小的空气囊，静止的空气是很好的绝热材料。

clips.send: 金属手柄（导体）。容易让热量通过。金属是热的良导体：热量很快从热锅沿着手柄传过来。金属中有可以自由移动的电子，能迅速传递能量。观察手柄：靠近锅的一端颜色更红，粒子振动更剧烈。过一会儿，手柄末端也烫得摸不得了！

clips.send: 水蒸气（热能）。粒子运动的能量。热能（内能）是物体内所有粒子动能的总和。水获得热能后分子运动加快，运动最快的分子从水面逃逸出来，成为水蒸气。沸腾时，多出来的能量用于把水分子彼此分开，而不是继续升温，所以沸水保持在 100 摄氏度 。
clips.text: 水蒸气（热能）. 粒子运动的能量. 热能（内能）是物体内所有粒子动能的总和。. 水获得热能后分子运动加快，运动最快的分子从水面逃逸出来，成为水蒸气。. 沸腾时，多出来的能量用于把水分子彼此分开，而不是继续升温，所以沸水保持在 100 °C。

clips.send: 容易混淆：不是“热量往上走”，而是密度变小的热“流体”往上走。热量本身可以向任何方向传递。

clips.send: 温度计（温度）。测量冷热程度。温度表示物质中粒子的平均动能。粒子运动越快，温度越高。在标准大气压下，水在 100 摄氏度 沸腾，在 0 摄氏度 结冰。温度计里的液体受热膨胀，所以会沿着细管上升。
clips.text: 温度计（温度）. 测量冷热程度. 温度表示物质中粒子的平均动能。. 粒子运动越快，温度越高。在标准大气压下，水在 100 °C 沸腾，在 0 °C 结冰。. 温度计里的液体受热膨胀，所以会沿着细管上升。

clips.send: 热传导（锅底）。通过接触传递热量。在热的电炉丝接触锅底的地方，炉丝中剧烈振动的粒子撞击锅底的粒子。每个粒子把能量传给相邻的粒子，就像人群中传球一样，粒子本身并不移动位置。热传导在固体中最快，尤其是金属，因为固体中的粒子排列得很紧密。
